title: Shared space scan
summary: Observe one shared place and note what helps or harms care.
objectives: Note one problem and one strength
briefMarkdown:
## Mission

Pick a shared place you use (school yard, lane, bus stop).

Spend 10 minutes noticing:
- What looks cared for?
- What looks neglected?
- Who uses this space?

Do not confront anyone. Observe only.

options.label: Blame the first person you see
Notice patterns and write them down calmly
Ignore litter because it is normal
Post angry videos with faces visible

quiz.teachBack: Good civic work starts with calm noticing, not public shaming.

fieldPrompt: Write 3 bullet notes: one strength, one problem, one question.
successCriteria: Avoids blaming individuals in the write-up

steady.coachNote: Ask who benefits if the space improves.

fast.coachNote: Ask for a root-cause guess with humility.

llm.tutorBrief: Safety and dignity. No doxxing. No trespass. Keep observations constructive.
